name: What closing costs can I expect when selling a luxury property in Florida?

mainEntity.name: What closing costs can I expect when selling a luxury property in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Closing costs for sellers in Florida typically include title insurance (owner's policy, often negotiated), documentary stamp taxes on the deed, outstanding property taxes, HOA/condo estoppel fees, and potentially attorney fees. For luxury homes, these costs can be substantial due to higher property values. It's important to get a detailed estimate from your real estate professional early in the process. Your agent at Realty ONE Group Evolution can help clarify these costs, ensuring transparency before an offer is accepted.
acceptedAnswer.description: Seller closing costs in Florida for luxury properties include title insurance, documentary stamp taxes, property taxes, and HOA fees, which can be significant due to higher values.
